trans.sense: device for domestic use, in the kitchen, or in war

examples.text: We have convenient storage for all the kitchen/eating utensils.

glosses: An instrument or device for domestic use, especially in the kitchen.

examples.text: He stocked up on old-style writing utensils.
Relations, sparing no expense'll/Send some useless old utensil,/Or a matching pen and pencil./"just the thing I need! how nice!"

glosses: A useful small tool, implement, or vessel.
